exceptions.reason: Toast-first and Clover-later POS feeds contain the same February event key.

exceptions.reason: Clover March revenue exceeds the synthetic bank control total by one dollar.

exceptions.limitingEvidence: The fixture does not establish whether the difference is timing, fee treatment, or a source error.
exceptions.nextAction: Request the bounded settlement detail needed to classify the difference before drawing a conclusion.
